🗳️ Election update: 91% of voting districts are now counted (21,532 of 23,696). All figures are provisional.

National (proportional ballot): ANC 31.8%, DA 24.1%, MK 9.5%, EFF 6.3%, ActionSA 5.4%, IFP 5.0%. Turnout is about 52%, according to the IEC.

The big change: Mangaung is now neck and neck. The ANC has 34.2% and the DA 34.0%, with 89% of the city counted. This morning the DA was ahead.

The other metros:
🏙️ Johannesburg: DA 39.0%, ANC 18.3%, ActionSA 16.5%
🏛️ Tshwane: DA 32.1%, ActionSA 24.4%, ANC 21.4%
🏭 Ekurhuleni: DA 29.5%, ANC 21.9%, ActionSA 20.5%
🌴 eThekwini: MK 40.0%, DA 24.4%, ANC 16.6%
Cape Town (DA), Nelson Mandela Bay (DA) and Buffalo City (ANC) are unchanged in order.

What it means for your pocket: Cape Town is still the only metro where one party has more than half the vote. The other seven are heading for coalitions, and those deals will decide your rates, tariffs and service budgets.

Gauteng and KwaZulu-Natal still have the most districts to count. The IEC plans to announce the official results on Sunday.
